policy.reviewed_current: Mapped bounded entry receipt whose reviewed English and localized values match current source. This is a verified lower bound, not universal linguistic sign-off. Test-mode receipts are convention checks only.
policy.needs_rereview: Zero currently identified stale/open receipts in this bounded mapped set after the two exact follow-ups. This does not clear the separate 57 broad language mandates or unknown/unmapped entries.
policy.unreviewed_or_unknown: Present entries without a mapped current/stale entry receipt in this checkpoint; may have historical or partial-term evidence not yet reconciled. Does not assert nobody reviewed them.
policy.missing: No nonempty entry in exact canonical catalogue; parent-language inheritance and runtime fallback are distinct.
policy.arithmetic: reviewed_current + needs_rereview + unreviewed_or_unknown + missing = total (698) per choice. Broad reset flags are not added to that sum.
policy.broad_reset: 57 original natural/regional catalogues retain broader independent/reconciliation obligations even when bounded current receipts exist. These are language-level obligations, not a proven key-by-key count of previous reviews.
policy.scope: Fresh Indonesian current-pair review accepted; Russian full plural accepted after the four warning corrections were independently reviewed and merged in PR62. No entry outside these explicitly accepted batches gains review credit. This tracker update changes no app source/workflow/release. Ten French shape entries independently accepted unchanged in source context; P05-003, GH-013 and CAT-021 remain open. Exactly one Cebuano TIFF-description receipt is added after PR64 merge and exact-pair binding; the separately proposed checkbox amendment remains unapplied. Four additional complete French Save/export and unsaved-changes entries are independently accepted unchanged in static source context; no runtime/rendering claim or broader mandate closure.
policy.no_human_prerequisite: Native-speaker certification is not claimed and is not introduced as a mandatory gate.
